results.title: Rugby-Improved scrum epitomises Irish steps forward, Farrell says
results.description: DUBLIN, Nov 21 (Reuters) - Ireland coach Andy Farrell said the turnaround in his side's scrum from being decimated by South Africa last year to standing up in Saturday's 20-17 win epitomised the progress they are making towards next year's World Cup.

results.title: BYU escapes Kansas with 3-OT win, preserving College Football Playoff chances
results.description: Kansas was a 2-point conversion away from a top-10 win that would have effectively eliminated the Cougars from the Playoff race.

results.title: Who is Austin Mack? Alabama’s backup QB starts with Keelon Russell resting
results.description: Austin Mack is Alabama’s backup quarterback, and on Saturday he made his first career start for the No. 3 Alabama Crimson Tide against Chattanooga. He started because Keelon Russell sat out to rest an ankle injury, Yea Alabama reported before kickoff.

results.title: Mets, A.J. Ewing agree to 8-year, $95 million extension
results.description: A.J. Ewing, the New York Mets’ center fielder, agreed on Saturday to an eight-year, $95 million contract extension, according to reports. SNY was first to report the agreement, which also carries a club option for a ninth season and still needs Ewing to pass a physical.
